cohort_definition: Proposed primary evaluation cohort of 55 high confidence ClinVar concordant biological candidates (2-star multiple submitters consensus or 3-star expert panel review) deterministically evaluated against NM_000518.5.
dataset_name: HBB Gene Mutation Analyzer — Phase 2C Primary Evaluation Dataset
exclusion_rule: Clinical conflicts without consensus, molecular discrepancies, out-of-bounds boundaries (promoter variants > -50 bp), single submitters without expert review (retained in Conditional), historical Phase 2B test fixtures and exclusion patterns.
inclusion_rule: Criteria provided with multiple submitters and no conflicts (ClinVar 2 stars) or reviewed by expert panel (ClinVar 3 stars); exact concordance between deterministic engine and external consequence category; transcript coordinates within NM_000518.5 model.
limitations: Zero representation in C05, C07, C08, C10 due to quality-constrained curation boundaries and reference transcript limits. Quality over quotas strictly enforced. These absences reflect curation constraints, not absence of biological variants.
provenance_policy: All candidates originate from NCBI ClinVar records. External database classifications are treated as repository claims, not molecular truth. Independent non-ClinVar corroboration has not been established (count = 0).
scientific_scope: Designed strictly to evaluate deterministic molecular consequence transformation under NM_000518.5. Does NOT establish clinical pathogenicity accuracy, diagnostic accuracy, clinical validity, or population prevalence.
